description: A solid red clip sliding right by half the raster's width over 32 frames, which on a 64-pixel raster is one pixel per frame — position is a fraction of the raster, and `0.5` of 64 is 32. Frame 0 is unmoved and covers the frame; by frame 16 the left half is the black it vacated. Position read as pixels rather than as a fraction, applied in the wrong direction, or evaluated once for the whole clip instead of per frame all fail here — and the first is the loudest, because half a pixel of travel over the whole clip would leave the frame red throughout.
